label: Azure compute
source_title: Microsoft 10-Q, quarter to Sep 30 2025, Note 17
quote: OpenAI contracted an incremental $250B of Azure services.

quote: About $300B of compute over roughly five years, starting 2027.
estimate_note: $300B / 5 years = ~$60B/yr. Oracle RPO is $638B, of which >$300B is OpenAI.

quote: $38B deal (Nov 2025) plus $100B over eight years.
